title: Reviewing a Flow Page
meta: flow with real screenshots · browser frame · crop and dark screenshots · 0.32.0

lead.answer: A reviewer opens each screen, follows its links, and ticks it when it is right.
points: Every screen here is a real screenshot of `sign-in-flow.html`, taken at device scale 2.
The map has a dark screenshot too: press Dark and it swaps.
Review marks stay in the reviewer's browser, not in the page.

flows.label: Review a flow page
flows.summary: From opening the page to a finished review, including switching flows and themes.

states.title: The map
states.note: Wide flows open at the zoom that fits. Drag to move; Ctrl + wheel to zoom. Press Dark: this screen has a dark screenshot.

states.title: Full-size screen
states.note: It lists where the screen comes from and every link out of it. Click a scaled screenshot to see it at full size.

states.title: Full-size decision
states.note: Each answer is a button. Red buttons are error paths.

states.title: Ticked screens
states.note: A tick dims the screen and adds a green mark. It clears by itself when the screen changes.

states.title: Review count
states.note: The crop key cuts the counter out of the full screenshot, and the width key shows it at its real size.

states.title: Another flow
states.note: One page can hold several flows. Each has its own review count.
